title: How to Run Spotify Ads: Costs & Key Considerations | Tinuiti

facts.fact: Spotify reports reaching over 602 million users, including 236 million subscribers, across 180 markets.
facts.quote: reaching over 602[million users](https://newsroom.spotify.com/company-info/), including 236 million subscribers, across 180 markets.

facts.fact: Spotify's active users spend on average 148 minutes a day listening, per the article.
facts.quote: The platform’s active users spend on average 148 minutes a day listening to their favorite music app

facts.fact: The article states Spotify has a valuation of over $72 billion.
facts.quote: With a[valuation of over $72 billion]

facts.fact: Over 317 million users are engaged with the ad-supported tier of Spotify, according to the article citing Spotify's Q1 2023 earnings.
facts.quote: Currently, over[317 million users](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/news-and-insights/spotify-first-quarter-earnings-2023/)are engaged with the ad-supported tier of the platform

facts.fact: Spotify reports 300 million+ ad-supported listeners available to advertisers.
facts.quote: **300 million+ ad-supported listeners**

facts.fact: Per a Nielsen study cited in the article, Spotify audio ads led to a 24% increase in ad recall among listeners.
facts.quote: [a study by Nielsen](https://ads.spotify.com/en-SG/news-and-insights/the-power-of-audio-chapter-2/)found that Spotify audio ads led to a 24% increase in ad recall

facts.fact: Per the same Nielsen study cited in the article, Spotify audio ads led to a 17% increase in purchase intent among listeners.
facts.quote: a 17% increase in purchase intent among listeners.

facts.fact: Per the article, 32% of Americans now listen to podcasts regularly.
facts.quote: **32% of Americans**now listen to podcasts regularly

facts.fact: Spotify's audio ads have a maximum length of 30 seconds.
facts.quote: With a maximum length of 30 seconds, these ads efficiently deliver messages to the

facts.fact: Spotify's free ad-supported tier uses 15 and 30-second ad breaks.
facts.quote: supported by 15 and 30-second ad breaks.

facts.fact: Spotify's Video Ad Takeover on mobile has a strict limit of 30 seconds.
facts.quote: With a strict limit of 30 seconds and a maximum file size of 500 MB

facts.fact: Spotify Video Ad Takeover ads are displayed with a 16:9 ratio in portrait or landscape orientation.
facts.quote: Displayed in either portrait or landscape orientation with a 16:9 ratio

facts.fact: The article cites Spotify stating audio-only campaigns tend to drive more foot traffic at a more efficient cost per visit than multi-format campaigns.
facts.quote: “when compared to multi-format campaigns, audio-only campaigns tend to drive more foot traffic to stores at a more efficient cost per visit.”

facts.fact: Spotify Overlay Ads close automatically after 30 seconds if the user does not click the 'X'.
facts.quote: allowing it to automatically close after 30 seconds

facts.fact: Spotify Homepage Takeover (desktop) features the advertiser's brand message on the Desktop Homepage for a full 24 hours.
facts.quote: prominently feature their brand message on the front page of Spotify’s Desktop Homepage for a full 24 hours

facts.fact: Audio is not supported in the Spotify Homepage Takeover (desktop) format, though videos can be included.
facts.quote: audio is not supported in this format, although videos can be included to enhance the visual impact

facts.fact: Spotify Leaderboard ads are clickable ads that appear for 30 seconds during a listening session when Spotify is in view.
facts.quote: clickable ads that appear for 30 seconds, exclusively during a listening session when Spotify is in view

facts.fact: Spotify Leaderboard ads support images or short animations lasting up to 15 seconds.
facts.quote: With support for images or short animations lasting up to 15 seconds

facts.fact: Spotify Sponsored Session Video ads must be 30 seconds or less in duration.
facts.quote: The video ad must adhere to a duration of 30 seconds or less

facts.fact: Spotify Sponsored Session Video ads offer mobile listeners 30 minutes of ad-free listening in exchange for watching a video ad.
facts.quote: 30 minutes of ad-free listening in exchange for watching a video ad on their phone

facts.fact: Tinuiti states Spotify Sponsored Session Video ads are generally considered more expensive than audio ads, though specific pricing varies.
facts.quote: they are generally considered to be more expensive than audio ads due to their enhanced engagement potential

facts.fact: Spotify podcast pre-recorded ads are typically audio clips ranging from 15 to 60 seconds.
facts.quote: typically audio clips ranging from 15 to 60 seconds, are strategically inserted within episodes

facts.fact: Spotify Sponsored Playlist features Kia as an example advertiser that sponsored the New Music Friday playlist.
facts.quote: For example, Kia recently sponsored Spotify’s New Music Friday playlist

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio provides a cost estimator tool to estimate production costs.
facts.quote: Spotify Ad Studio provides a cost estimator tool

facts.fact: Spotify audio and video ads use a basic auction system offering bid caps, with targeting options including Cost per Impression or maximum CPM bid.
facts.quote: Both audio and video ads utilize a basic auction system familiar to digital advertisers, offering bid caps

facts.fact: Spotify states that daily budgets are guidelines rather than strict caps, because Spotify may adjust spending based on demand.
facts.quote: daily budgets are not strict caps but guidelines, as Spotify may adjust spending based on demand to maximize your ad’s impact.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio bid caps are a hard cap on how much an advertiser will spend to place a single ad, unlike the budget.
facts.quote: Unlike your budget, this _is_ a hard cap on how much you’ll spend to place a single ad.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio lets advertisers set frequency caps on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.
facts.quote: You can set frequency caps on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio's Clicks objective charges advertisers only when a user clicks the ad.
facts.quote: With this objective, you’ll only pay if someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: The author states that the Clicks objective is almost always the most expensive Spotify Ad Studio objective.
facts.quote: Clicks are almost always the most expensive option, but it’s perfect for brands seeking to increase conversions.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio's Impressions objective is based on how many times an ad is served, not how many people it reaches.
facts.quote: Unlike reach, this is based on how many times the ad is served, rather than how many people it reaches.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio lets advertisers exclude ads from podcasts labeled as sensitive.
facts.quote: You also have the option to exclude your ads from appearing during podcasts labeled as “sensitive.”

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio gives marketers control over campaign start and end dates down to the minute.
facts.quote: Spotify gives marketers precise control over the start and end dates for the campaign, right down to the minute.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio supports audio, horizontal video, and vertical video ad formats.
facts.quote: Start by selecting your ad format—be it audio, horizontal video, or vertical video.

facts.fact: In Spotify Ad Studio, advertisers can choose to place ads across both music and podcasts or limit them to music only.
facts.quote: choose if you want to place these ads across music and podcasts or limit them to music only.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio asks advertisers whether they are promoting something music-related or representing a brand, and music-related ads are for artists or those in the periphery of the music business.
facts.quote: Music-related ads are for artists or those in periphery of the music business, like sellers of concert tickets and merchandise.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio targeting options include age and demographics, city and geography, devices and connectivity, genre/playlists/podcasts, predicted interests (lookalike), off-platform behaviors, and past interactions.
facts.quote: Ad Studio allows you to target audiences based on:

facts.fact: Spotify allows advertisers to set budgets as either daily budgets or lifetime budgets.
facts.quote: Spotify lets you approach this in two ways: Daily budgets and lifetime budgets.

facts.fact: Spotify Ad Studio provides a deliverability gauge that estimates how much budget is needed to reach the intended audience and the likelihood of fully using the daily budget.
facts.quote: take note of Spotify’s deliverability gauge on the right side of the page.

facts.fact: Spotify's in-house creative team can produce audio ads, including background tunes and script writing, from a creative brief provided by the advertiser.
facts.quote: use Spotify’s in house creative team to produce your ad, including background tunes and even script writing.

facts.fact: Spotify's direct buying option, which involves collaborating with the Spotify team for custom experiences or guaranteed inventory, may not suit all advertisers due to its costs.
facts.quote: although this option may not be suitable for all advertisers due to associated costs.

facts.fact: For video ad formats in Spotify Ad Studio, viewability tracking is available through third-party vendors.
facts.quote: additional capabilities for viewability tracking via third-party vendors.

facts.fact: Spotify's Ad Studio provides initial campaign results within 24 hours of an ad going live.
facts.quote: Ad Studio provides initial results within 24 hours of your ad going live, allowing you to quickly assess its performance.

facts.fact: The Tinuiti article was originally published in May 2018 and later updated.
facts.quote: This post was originally published in May 2018 and has been updated for freshness, accuracy, and comprehensiveness.
